table.note: 62069 of 62161 gene identifiers are of the kind Ensembl gene; agent: Each tar member is a headerless two-column table of Ensembl gene ID and an integer count (values 0, 1, 2, ...), in files named ".Counts.txt.gz", so they are raw per-gene read counts. All 620 samples have a member whose name starts with the sample accession, so every sample is given.
